title: Keep approved Tailscale sharing until manual disconnect
summary: Remove the two-minute inactivity and four-hour limits for approved direct sessions. Keep the sharing service available when leaving the app or during a temporary Tailscale outage.

changes.detail: Remove inactivity and total-duration expiry from approved direct Tailscale sessions, and remove viewer pause/reconnect deadlines.
Retain the approved service during temporary loss of the original Tailscale address; resume when that address returns. Heartbeat still pauses frames and controls during viewer absence.

Update English, French and Arabic session guidance and prepare Android 1.0.13/build 15. Keep explicit Stop controls, owner approval, ten-minute unapproved pairing expiry and Android capture revocation handling.
Regression coverage for 24-hour idle/pause/reconnect and pending approval expiry.

validation.name: Implementation checks
validation.detail: TypeScript, lint, viewer/history tests, native JVM tests and signed APK verification pending.

validation.name: Physical device acceptance
validation.detail: No device connected. Android force-stop, process death, reboot, capture revocation and screen lock can end sharing. Rotation still ends capture. Tailscale must return on its original address. Viewer process recreation requires new pairing; external relay mode retains its existing policy. No deployment.
